{
  "working_thesis": "Human plurality, grounded in natality and actualized through speech and action, constitutes the unique realm of human affairs and political life. Although action is plagued by the predicaments of irreversibility, unpredictability, and anonymity, and has historically tempted thinkers to substitute making and rule for acting, it carries within itself intrinsic remedies—forgiving and promising—that enable human beings to live together in freedom and hope.",
